inputSchemaCoverage: Command envelopes and documented nested fields; adapter, revision, applicability and physical validation remain authoritative.

operations.description: Read the current two-case comparison panel as a portable preset plus its exact configuration revision.
limitations: Argument envelope only; runtime validation remains authoritative.
Incomplete or invalid panel selection returns archive:null and a reason while retaining a revision usable for compare-and-swap import.
Returns {schemaVersion:1,revision,archive,reason?}; portable sources identify saved case content hashes, not runtime case IDs. Does not render or change the panel.
